author: barnabasbusa
content: https://github.com/libp2p/specs/pull/732

author: vladimir_ea
content: yes - but this just defines the message frame not the content for each topic / message type

author: vladimir_ea
content:
so waggle gives you a stream for a topic and a message format: object id, metadata and data - it doesn't say what those are in terms of data types - that is up to the application. Also , in terms of replacing gossip, it does not define things like mesh maintenance, scoring, how grafting / pruning, haves wants etc work - these are delegated to the application - so you can pick the right approach for the  type of traffic. 

seacast *does* define those things but is also more opinionated about e.g. how the data is encoded.
